summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.reverse in its single in-scope file, following the spec steps. ToObject and LengthOfArrayLike run first, with `?` propagation. The loop runs while lower != middle, with upper = length - lower - 1. Each iteration does HasProperty(lower), Get(lower) only if it exists, HasProperty(upper), Get(upper) only if it exists, then the four-way Set/Delete branching as in steps h-k, and lower += 1. The observable operations happen in spec order and count. It returns obj. Length 0 and 1 fall out of the loop naturally. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no fabricated values, and no edits outside the file. The gate's four remaining failures come from unimplemented Reflect.get and BigInt elsewhere in the engine, which is the honest not-implemented path. I could not verify that with_roots restores the root stack when a `?` exits the closure early, or that key_from_index and push_root_key behave as the diff assumes. Those are outside the diff, so I did not count them as defects.
